# Implementation Plan: Real Google Drive API Integration & GEE Export Pipeline

Connect the existing Tamil Nadu Environmental Monitoring project to real Google Drive API access, establish independent Drive authentication and diagnostics (`npm run diagnose:drive`), and execute the authentic end-to-end pipeline:

$$\text{REAL GEE IMAGE} \longrightarrow \text{GEE EXPORT TO DRIVE} \longrightarrow \text{DRIVE FILE VERIFICATION} \longrightarrow \text{LOCAL DOWNLOAD} \longrightarrow \text{GEOTIFF VALIDATION} \longrightarrow \text{SPECTRAL INDICES} \longrightarrow \text{BASELINE ACTIVATION}$$

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Google Drive OAuth Scope Authorization for Local Development**
> Our inspection confirms:
> 1. Google Earth Engine API and Google Drive API are **both enabled** in Google Cloud project `monitoring-system-506515`.
> 2. GEE authentication via Application Default Credentials (ADC) is **working and verified** (discovery returns 200 OK with authentic Sentinel-2 scenes).
> 3. However, standard ADC tokens for `jeyaseelan2348@gmail.com` currently only have Cloud Platform scopes (`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform`). Calling `drive.googleapis.com` returns `ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT (403)` because Drive explicitly requires Drive-specific OAuth scopes (`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive` or `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file` / `drive.readonly`).
> 
> To grant Google Drive access to your local ADC credentials, run:
> ```bash
> gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access --update-adc
> ```
> *(A browser tab has been launched on your machine at `http://localhost:8085/` waiting for you to sign in with `jeyaseelan2348@gmail.com` and grant Drive permission).*
> 
> The application will independently detect whether Drive access is granted, reporting `DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED` if scopes are absent, and only proceeding with the real export pipeline once Drive access is confirmed.

> [!WARNING]
> **Zero-Simulation Policy**
> In accordance with the prompt requirements:
> - No fake Drive file IDs will be generated.
> - No mock downloads or fallback generators will be used for production operations.
> - If Drive authentication is missing or fails, the pipeline will return an explicit `DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED` error.
> - If an export completes but the file is not found on Drive, the pipeline will return `DRIVE_FILE_MISSING`.
> - Baselines will strictly remain non-active (`isActive: false`) until all 14 safety criteria are met with real files.

---

## Proposed Changes

### Component 1: Dedicated Google Drive Authentication & Client

#### [MODIFY] [GoogleDriveService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/drive/GoogleDriveService.ts)
- Separate Google Drive authentication from GEE authentication.
- Create an independent GoogleAuth / OAuth2 client configured with:
  - Scopes: `['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly']`
  - Fallback check for `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`, environment refresh tokens (`DRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN` / `GEE_REFRESH_TOKEN`), and standard ADC.
- In `checkDriveAccess()`:
  - Call `drive.about.get({ fields: 'user, storageQuota' })` or `drive.files.list({ pageSize: 1 })`.
  - Return `{ success: true, email: user.emailAddress }` or throw `DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED` with exact descriptive failure reasons.
- In `findExportedFile(fileName)`:
  - Search by file name prefix in the designated folder (`TN-Forest-Monitoring/GEE-Exports` or root/configured folder).
  - Verify `file.id`, `file.size > 0`, and return authentic metadata.
- In `downloadGeoTiff()`:
  - Stream binary GeoTIFF directly from Google Drive API to `storage/raster_temp/{jobId}/`.
  - Verify downloaded byte size matches Drive file size.
  - Remove all mock fallbacks in non-test mode.

---

### Component 2: Independent Diagnostic Script (`npm run diagnose:drive`)

#### [NEW] [diagnoseDrive.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/scripts/diagnoseDrive.ts)
- Implement independent Google Drive diagnostic command:
  1. Authenticate against Google Drive API using configured ADC / OAuth2 credentials.
  2. Verify Drive API access via `drive.about.get` and `drive.files.list`.
  3. Output formatted diagnostic logs:
     ```
     [DRIVE]
     Authentication: SUCCESS

     [DRIVE]
     Authenticated Drive access: SUCCESS

     [DRIVE]
     Account/file visibility: SUCCESS
     Account: jeyaseelan2348@gmail.com
     Files visible in Drive: <count>
     ```
  4. If scopes are missing or API fails, output exact diagnostic reason:
     ```
     [DRIVE]
     Authentication: FAILED (DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED)
     Reason: Insufficient authentication scopes (ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT)
     Action Required: Run 'gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access --update-adc'
     ```
  5. Never log access tokens, refresh tokens, or client secrets.

#### [MODIFY] [package.json](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/package.json)
- Add script entry: `"diagnose:drive": "tsx src/scripts/diagnoseDrive.ts"`.

---

### Component 3: Real GEE Export Pipeline Connection

#### [MODIFY] [GeeExportService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/gee/GeeExportService.ts)
- Connect real GEE export request to user's Google Drive destination:
  - Image: `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM`
  - Zone: Sathiyar (`coordinates: [[[78.0747, 10.1182], [78.0867, 10.1118], [78.0939, 10.1196], [78.0890, 10.1235], [78.0797, 10.1228], [78.0747, 10.1182]]]`)
  - Destination: `driveDestination: { folder: 'TN-Forest-Monitoring/GEE-Exports', filenamePrefix: ... }`
  - Bands: Optical surface reflectance `['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8', 'B11', 'B12']` (homogeneous UInt16).

#### [MODIFY] [BaselineService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/BaselineService.ts)
- Verify that when `executeAsyncBaselinePipeline()` runs:
  - GEE task is polled until `state === 'SUCCEEDED'`.
  - Drive service finds real file via `findExportedFile()`.
  - If Drive returns scope error, records `status: BaselineStatus.DRIVE_FILE_MISSING` and `failureReason: "DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED: ..."`.
  - Persists real `driveFileId`, `driveFileName`, and `driveFileSizeBytes`.
  - Downloads real GeoTIFF and validates dimensions, bands, and CRS before calculating spectral indices.

#### [NEW] [executeRealBaselinePipeline.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/scripts/executeRealBaselinePipeline.ts)
- Standalone runner script to execute the end-to-end real pipeline for Sathiyar zone and target Sentinel-2 scene:
  1. Verifies GEE auth and Drive auth.
  2. Triggers real GEE export task to Drive.
  3. Polls task on Earth Engine.
  4. Discovers exported file on Google Drive.
  5. Downloads GeoTIFF locally.
  6. Validates raster geometry & bands.
  7. Computes NDVI, NDWI, NDBI.
  8. Activates baseline under 14-point safety gate.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Diagnostics
1. **GEE Diagnostic**:
   ```bash
   npm run diagnose:gee
   ```
   *Expect*: Authentication SUCCESS, Real image discovery SUCCESS.

2. **Drive Diagnostic**:
   ```bash
   npm run diagnose:drive
   ```
   *Expect*: Authentication SUCCESS, Authenticated Drive access SUCCESS, Account/file visibility SUCCESS.

3. **Master Regression Suite**:
   ```bash
   npx tsx src/tests/run-all-tests.ts
   ```
   *Expect*: All 29 regression test suites pass with 0 failures.

4. **TypeScript Verification**:
   ```bash
   npm run typecheck
   ```
   *Expect*: 0 errors on both server and client.

### Manual / Live Pipeline Verification
- Execute `tsx src/scripts/executeRealBaselinePipeline.ts`.
- Verify real GEE task completion on Earth Engine.
- Verify exported `.tif` file appears in Google Drive with authentic `driveFileId` and non-zero byte size.
- Verify real GeoTIFF downloaded and spectral indices computed.
